text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san. Thank you so 
much for giving me yesterday off!
choice_data_list: Did you enjoy your day off?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thanks to you! I got to do so many 
things, it was a really fulfilling day.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Going shopping with friends, helping 
rearrange rooms! Helping till the fields 
was a ton of fun too~♪

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Taking a breather really is important, 
isn't it? I still have plenty of requests 
left, so I'd love to continue on my next 
day off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looked like Dantsu Flame was able to 
spend a thoroughly fulfilling day.
